'''yoda Insignificant Rebellion Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me

== Strategy ==

I try to force my opponent to battle me on Tatooine because of my force drains as well as Tatooine occupation. I then use my walkers, bounty hunters, and Maul to win a couple of battles before using Vader to bring Luke to the Emperor to face his destiny.

Also, I have a lot of used interrupts so i won't use up my deck. I have fairly high destiny, excluding my characters, and I can easily hit any Jedi with my lightsabers.
